generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: GM Ultium-based (built by GM in Ramos Arizpe): 85 kWh pack, CCS1 port (no native NACS through 2026), FWD or AWD. 2025 got a range increase (308/294 mi), 2026 carried over pack and hardware. One generation. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.cargurus.com/Cars/articles/2026-honda-prologue-pricing-specs-release-date ; https://www.hondainfocenter.com/2026/prologue/feature-guide/specifications/
